tuning.selection: For each maze and values variant separately, maximize equally weighted checkpoint-mean validation success, averaged equally over five seeds. Scores within 1e-12 tie; choose the smallest requested relabel proportion.
tuning.budgets: same registered 2M/4M budgets and points as final grid

final_grid.tuned_parameters: apply the registered per-maze per-variant selection mechanically

analysis.primary: test success averaged equally over points within each seed, then mean and SE over twenty seeds
analysis.paired_interval: marginal Student t(19) 95%; critical value 2.093024054408263; no multiplicity correction
analysis.threshold: first nominal point at which across-seed mean test success reaches archived phase-4b ACS2 mean final test success; no interpolation; null if never reached
analysis.baseline_reuse: archived phase-4b grid only; seed-42 replay is a regression check, not a new baseline grid

execution.tuning_batches: one group per maze, both values variants and all proportions; 20 or 30 jobs, each reserves the larger values-agent limit
execution.limit_rule: max(2, ceil((1.5 * seed42 body wall at registered budget + 30) / 60)) minutes; node process watchdog retains 30 seconds; this is a sizing margin, not a guarantee about new-seed growth
execution.guards: shared experiments/grid tools; clean pinned musl source and binary, node-side guards, STOP on failure; no lease, pinning or laptop dependency
execution.accounting: allocation CPUTimeRAW once per attempt, including failed attempts and regression pilots; spent plus reserved plus new limits at most 60 CPU-hours
execution.copies: cluster and local raw artifacts independently checksum-verified

cost_evidence.sizing_evidence: Archived phase-4b maximum body/seed42 ratios <=1.477 on Maze4--7 and <=1.517 overall; local HER body/seed42 ratios <=1.475 except small MazeMA control (1.830), whose two-minute minimum exceeds three times pilot body. Full-budget new-seed growth is unknown; STOP and remaining 4.820833 CPU-hours protect retries.

u1_observer.purpose: cost recalibration after read-only U1 telemetry; all prior attempts retained

u1_learning_equivalence.population_rng_and_replay: exactly equal to unchanged core; differing telemetry and sidecar logical bytes only
